Yes, [Global Industrial](https://www.globalindustrial.com/) is a direct-to-business industrial and commercial product distributor. - **Operations:** Operates multiple large distribution centers across North America to manage inventory and fulfillment.

- **Customer Base:** Serves commercial businesses, government agencies, educational institutions, and healthcare facilities. [](https://www.globaldata.com/company-profile/systemax-inc/)
